boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission art, garden, and outdoor activities on or near Rice, each supported by a direct current source.

cards.title: Take a self-guided Rice public-art walk
cards.subtitle: Across Rice University’s campus
cards.notes: Open the collection information, choose a few outdoor works, and walk between them together; the collection is available free to visitors and the public.
cards.short_summary: Make a flexible, no-ticket art walk across campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice says its Public Art collection across campus is always free and available to students, visitors, and the general public.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor works are spread across campus; use Rice Public Art information to select stops.

cards.title: Look through the Moody galleries
cards.subtitle: Rice University, 6100 Main Street
cards.notes: Meet in the exhibition spaces and take time with the work before discussing one piece each. Entry is free during the center’s public gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery visit on Rice’s arts campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Moody states that its exhibition spaces are open to the public and free of charge Tuesday through Saturday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.source_title: FAQ | Moody Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Public gallery hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Sunday, Monday, and holidays.

cards.title: Wander the Menil’s main galleries
cards.subtitle: Menil campus, 1533 Sul Ross Street
cards.notes: Start in the main building, move slowly through the galleries, and use the free gallery guides if you want prompts for a shared conversation.
cards.short_summary: Free access to the Menil’s central museum building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Menil says entry is always free and identifies its Main Building at 1533 Sul Ross Street as open to visitors.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; closed Monday and Tuesday. Food and beverages are not allowed inside.

cards.title: Compare drawings at the Drawing Institute
cards.subtitle: Menil campus, 1412 W Main Street
cards.notes: Pick a drawing that catches each person’s eye, then trade observations outside afterward. The institute is one of the Menil buildings open to visitors.
cards.short_summary: A focused, free stop for works on paper.
cards.evidence_claim: The Menil lists the Menil Drawing Institute among the buildings visitors can explore and states that entry to the Menil is always free.
cards.access_notes: Follow Menil public hours: Wednesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; verify exhibition availability before going.

cards.title: Spend time in the Cy Twombly Gallery
cards.subtitle: Menil campus, 1501 Branard Street
cards.notes: Use the gallery’s calm setting for an unhurried shared visit, then compare the marks, scale, and color choices you noticed in the paintings.
cards.short_summary: Free entry to a dedicated Cy Twombly gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Menil lists the Cy Twombly Gallery among the buildings visitors can explore and states that entry to the Menil is always free.
cards.access_notes: Open on the Menil’s Wednesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–7 p.m. schedule; photography is not permitted inside galleries.

cards.entity_name: Dan Flavin Installation at Richmond Hall
cards.title: See Dan Flavin’s fluorescent-light installation
cards.subtitle: Menil campus, 1500 Richmond Avenue
cards.notes: Make this a short shared stop: circle the installation, notice how the light shifts with your position, and talk through what changes from each angle.
cards.short_summary: A free, light-based artwork in a dedicated Menil space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Menil lists the Dan Flavin Installation at Richmond Hall among the buildings visitors can explore and states that entry to the Menil is always free.
cards.access_notes: Visit during the Menil’s Wednesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–7 p.m. public hours.

cards.title: Pause together at Rothko Chapel
cards.subtitle: 3900 Yupon at Sul Ross, Houston
cards.notes: Enter quietly, sit with the paintings for a few minutes, and continue your conversation outside. No ticket or admission charge is required.
cards.short_summary: A free, contemplative art-and-community space near Rice.
cards.evidence_claim: Rothko Chapel states that tickets are not required for entry and admission is free during normal operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m., including holidays; closed Monday.

cards.title: Walk the gardens and sculpture promenade
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park, 1500 Hermann Drive
cards.notes: Choose a loop through the rose, arid, and family gardens, then climb the garden mount or pause by the sculpture promenade before heading back.
cards.short_summary: A free garden walk with several distinct spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Hermann Park Conservancy states that McGovern Centennial Gardens are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: McGovern Centennial Gardens | Hermann Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: Hours change seasonally; the gardens are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. Groups require advance reservation.

cards.title: Stroll the Japanese Garden
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park, Houston
cards.notes: Follow the paths at an easy pace, pause at the water and plantings, and keep the outing simple—this garden is open daily with no admission charge.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost garden stroll in Hermann Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Hermann Park Conservancy states that the Japanese Garden is open daily and has no admission charge.
cards.source_title: Points of Interest | Hermann Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: Open daily; follow posted park rules and stay on designated paths.

cards.title: Catch a free Miller performance
cards.subtitle: Hermann Park, Houston
cards.notes: Check the schedule, bring a friend, and choose free hill seating or request a free covered-seat ticket when a performance offers them.
cards.short_summary: Free public performances in Hermann Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Miller Outdoor Theatre states that all its performances are free, with both covered and hill seating available at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Check the current performance schedule. Covered seating requires an assigned free ticket; hill seating is also free.

warnings: The James Turrell Twilight Epiphany Skyspace was excluded because its official page says it is closed to the public until fall 2026.
